أصطفي (form VIII)
# أَصْطَفِي (ʔaṣṭafī) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.fiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# أَصْطَفِيَ (ʔaṣṭafiya) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.fi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
